description:
[Game reference] Frankenstein pet parts and the stats they change. `parts`: each Frankenstein head/torso/legs part with flat changes to the pet's `speed`, `max_health`,
`attack_damage` and `attack_rate_s` (seconds between attacks: positive = slower). The only pet gear in this build. Link https://rust.wiki/pet-gear.
name: get_pet_gear
title: Frankenstein pet parts and the stats they change
